About Windcave:
Founded in 1999 in New Zealand, Windcave has consistently led the way in the innovation of payment technology. Today, our global footprint extends across 40+ countries, supported by a dedicated team of over 400+ experts. We process billions of transactions annually, providing businesses with a comprehensive payment solution through a single provider.
Our approach continuously sets new industry benchmarks and reflects our commitment to leading the market with self-developed, cutting-edge technologies. We support a wide range of industries, including retail, finance, hospitality, and more, with operations all over the globe.
About role:
This role will suit someone who is looking to learn about the industry or start their career and has interest in C++. It will be a full-time paid internship.
Ideally the candidate will have the following:
Currently in your second year and upwards of study/degree. An A+/A equivalent bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science engineering, Bachelor of Science or related field
Excellent attention to detail, with accurate data entry skills and technically savvy
Can work full-time.
Quick learner and passion for card and payments.
A growth mindset, be resilient and able to cope with change and a very fast-paced work environment.
Benefits:
Hybrid work option (Mandatory 3 days work from office Monday, Tuesday, and Friday).
Competitive remuneration package
Career Development and long-term career opportunity
Diverse, energetic and friendly team environment
Why Windcave:
At Windcave, you'll be part of a team that's reshaping the landscape of payment solutions and services. Our global presence and innovative approach set us apart in the payment industry, making Windcave a place where your work impacts businesses and consumers around the world.
Ready to Make an Impact?
If you're ready to embrace the challenge and join a company where innovation meets excellence, apply now and be part of our success story.
Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Are you currently studying?
How many years' experience do you have as a Software Development Intern?
How many hours are you available to work per week?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in New Zealand?
Have you completed a qualification in computer science?
Which of the following programming languages are you experienced in?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Because of the nature of our industry, we undertake a series of checks(credit/criminal/education/employment). Please let us know if you have anything adverse to declare w.r.t checks.
